notes: The CPT half of the OI-minted hybrid. Measured 2026-09-30 in a vocabulation build (ohdsi_vocabs.concept): 17,687 of CPT4_HCPCS's 30,357 concepts carry a CPT4-side concept_class_id (CPT4 13,686; CPT4 Hierarchy 3,787; CPT4 Modifier 164; Visit 50), and every one of their concept_codes is a CPT4 concept_code in the same build. The build records NO per-concept source column and mints its own concept_ids (100869996-100900671, none shared with CPT4 or HCPCS), so this split is read from concept_class_id and concept_code, not from recorded provenance. An edition lookup fanning out through this row honestly finds NOTHING: Athena builds CPT4 entirely from UMLS MRSMAP and we hold no UMLS licence, so CPT4 has no edition rows and cannot gain any. Do not invent CPT4_HCPCS editions to fill the gap - the hybrid has no publisher, release or cadence of its own (vocabulary_formats-909).

The HCPCS half. Same build, same date: 12,670 of the 30,357 concepts carry an HCPCS-side concept_class_id (HCPCS 12,179; HCPCS Class 106; HCPCS Modifier 385), and every one of their concept_codes is an HCPCS concept_code. 381 of them ALSO match a CPT4 concept_code - 380 HCPCS Modifiers plus 1 HCPCS code - and 544 - 380 = 164 is exactly the CPT4 Modifier count on the other row, consistent with each shared modifier appearing once, on this side. 17,687 + 12,670 = 30,357, and 0 hybrid concept_codes match neither parent, so these two rows are the whole composition. An edition lookup fanning out through this row finds HCPCS's own editions (CMS, quarterly), which is what the HCPCS label -> CPT4_HCPCS widening otherwise hides (vocabulary_formats-909).
